```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(htmltools)
```

## Interactive Map

Explore racial and ethnic demographics across census tracts in Sarasota County, Florida, based on the 2022 5-year American Community Survey (ACS). Use the controls in the top-right to switch between demographic layers, and hover over any tract to see detailed population shares.

```{r}
#| label: interactive-map
# Load spatial census data and compute demographic percentages
sarasota <- read_rds("data/sarasota_race.rds") |>
  filter(!is.na(totalE) & totalE > 0) |>
  mutate(
    pct_white = round(100 * whiteE / totalE, 1),
    pct_hispanic = round(100 * hispanicE / totalE, 1),
    pct_black = round(100 * blackE / totalE, 1),
    pct_asian = round(100 * asianE / totalE, 1)
  ) |>
  st_transform(crs = 4326)

# Color palettes for each demographic group
pal_hispanic <- colorNumeric("YlOrRd", domain = sarasota$pct_hispanic)
pal_black <- colorNumeric("Purples", domain = sarasota$pct_black)
pal_white <- colorNumeric("Blues", domain = sarasota$pct_white)

# Tooltip labels showing tract breakdown on hover
labels <- sprintf(
  "<strong>%s</strong><br/>Total Population: %s<br/>White: %.1f%%<br/>Hispanic: %.1f%%<br/>Black: %.1f%%<br/>Asian: %.1f%%",
  sarasota$NAME,
  scales::comma(sarasota$totalE),
  sarasota$pct_white,
  sarasota$pct_hispanic,
  sarasota$pct_black,
  sarasota$pct_asian
) |> lapply(HTML)

# Interactive Leaflet map with layer selection
leaflet(sarasota) |>
  addProviderTiles("CartoDB.Positron") |>
  addPolygons(
    group = "% Hispanic",
    fillColor = ~pal_hispanic(pct_hispanic),
    fillOpacity = 0.7,
    color = "white",
    weight = 1,
    highlightOptions = highlightOptions(weight = 2, color = "#444", fillOpacity = 0.9, bringToFront = TRUE),
    label = labels
  ) |>
  addPolygons(
    group = "% Black",
    fillColor = ~pal_black(pct_black),
    fillOpacity = 0.7,
    color = "white",
    weight = 1,
    highlightOptions = highlightOptions(weight = 2, color = "#444", fillOpacity = 0.9, bringToFront = TRUE),
    label = labels
  ) |>
  addPolygons(
    group = "% White",
    fillColor = ~pal_white(pct_white),
    fillOpacity = 0.7,
    color = "white",
    weight = 1,
    highlightOptions = highlightOptions(weight = 2, color = "#444", fillOpacity = 0.9, bringToFront = TRUE),
    label = labels
  ) |>
  addLayersControl(
    baseGroups = c("% Hispanic", "% Black", "% White"),
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  )
```
